action: Preserved as-is. The grid is NOT re-tuned and P1 is NOT re-run; that would be fitting the confirmation. Promotion remains blocked at step 4 of 5. A successor prediction requires a new ID, a new hash, and a grid constructed to span the boundary so that failure is possible.
differential_prediction_status: UNDEFINED, not failed. With sgd_divergence_rate = 0 the comparison 'adam_rate < 0.2 * sgd_rate' reduces to 0 < 0 and is reported False, but nothing was measured. The scored flag is misleading and is corrected here rather than in the frozen record.
headline: The prediction was not falsifiable on the frozen grid. Of 197 scored SGD cells, 197 could produce a false alarm and ZERO could produce a miss, because no cell reached rho >= 1.1. The reported 'primary_prediction_passes: True' is therefore half-vacuous and must not be read as a confirmation.
root_cause: Grid design error, frozen before checking. Learning rates 0.05-0.2 against a measured lambda_max(H_target) range of 0.510 to 10.876 put rho between 0.0128 and 1.0876. Reaching rho = 1 at the largest observed curvature needed a learning rate of about 0.18, and only a single cell got near it.
what_was_genuinely_tested: The rho < 1 => stable direction. 197 cells at rho <= 0.9, zero divergences. That is real evidence, and it is the only evidence this run produced.
what_was_not_tested: The rho > 1 => diverges direction. Zero cells above the critical band. The prediction was never given an opportunity to fail on the side that matters.
